lockscreens.name: Aurora
lockscreens.author: ZAAFHachemrachid
lockscreens.summary: Frosted glass over a slow aurora drift.
lockscreens.description: A glass card floats over the blurred wallpaper while soft aurora light drifts behind it. A compact clock, the user avatar, and a glowing password field sit on the card; suspend, restart and shut down stay on the bottom rail. Blur radius, card opacity, dimming and the 12/24-hour clock are all in theme.conf.

lockscreens.name: Tape
lockscreens.author: Darkkal44
lockscreens.summary: Clockwork mechanics drift across warm magnetic tape.
lockscreens.description: A complete qylock scene with a tactile clock face, deep shadow, and an amber tape-era palette.

lockscreens.name: Dog Samurai
lockscreens.author: Darkkal44
lockscreens.summary: A painterly samurai hound under drifting red petals.
lockscreens.description: A cinematic video lock: a straw-hatted samurai dog with a sheathed katana as crimson petals fall, paired with a bold clock and a minimal login.

lockscreens.name: Enfield
lockscreens.author: Darkkal44
lockscreens.summary: Golden hour spilling through a plant-framed window.
lockscreens.description: A warm, atmospheric lock: late sun pours past ivy and a weathered window frame, with a quiet login.

lockscreens.name: Field

lockscreens.summary: An open pasture under soft light with a feather-light clock.
lockscreens.description: A serene qylock scene: a wide field, a thin Orbitron clock, and a quiet amber login tucked into the corner.

lockscreens.name: Forest

lockscreens.summary: Sunbeams pouring through a misty autumn canopy.

lockscreens.summary: A lone blossom tree adrift in cold grey mist.

lockscreens.summary: A four-key note highway glowing in neon green.
lockscreens.description: An osu!mania inspired lock: vertical scrolling notes, key-binding widgets, and PERFECT combos over a dark stage.

lockscreens.summary: A warm pixel cafe glowing after dark.
lockscreens.description: A cosy pixel-art lock: amber lamps over a late-night cafe, city lights through the window, and a tidy login.

lockscreens.summary: A neon pixel-art cityscape humming with rain and signage.
lockscreens.description: An animated pixel-art cyberpunk street, all neon reflections and drizzle, with a crisp login.

lockscreens.summary: A red-lit pixel skyline smouldering at dusk.

lockscreens.summary: A little companion on a grassy hill under summer clouds.
lockscreens.description: A bright pixel-art lock: a small creature resting on green grass beneath towering white clouds, with a clean login.

lockscreens.name: Pixel Night City
lockscreens.author: Darkkal44
lockscreens.summary: A glittering pixel skyline humming after dark.
lockscreens.description: A pixel-art lock: dense neon-lit towers over shadowed rooftops, cool and electric, with a crisp login.

lockscreens.summary: A rainy night at the desk, monitor aglow.

lockscreens.summary: A pixel-art courtyard under drifting cherry blossom.
lockscreens.description: An animated pixel-art scene of falling sakura petals, warm and unhurried, with a tidy login.

lockscreens.name: Pixel Skyscrapers
lockscreens.author: Darkkal44
lockscreens.summary: A pastel dawn washing over a layered skyline.
lockscreens.description: A pixel-art lock: peach-and-mauve skies and a soft sun behind stacked skyscrapers, with a calm login.

lockscreens.name: Pixel Waterfall
lockscreens.author: Darkkal44
lockscreens.summary: A tranquil pixel-art waterfall in a mossy glen.
lockscreens.description: An animated pixel-art waterfall scene, cool and green, with a calm minimal login.

lockscreens.name: Reverse: 1999
lockscreens.author: Darkkal44
lockscreens.summary: A pensive period portrait bathed in soft sepia light.
lockscreens.description: A Reverse: 1999 inspired lock centred on a wistful character portrait in warm vintage tones, with an understated login.

lockscreens.name: Reverse: 1999
lockscreens.author: Darkkal44
lockscreens.summary: Vintage flourish with an animated period backdrop.
lockscreens.description: A Reverse: 1999 inspired lock with an animated vintage backdrop, a period logo, and an elegant login.

lockscreens.name: Star Rail
lockscreens.author: Darkkal44
lockscreens.summary: An astral, animated backdrop for the trailblazers.
lockscreens.description: A Honkai: Star Rail inspired lock with an animated cosmic backdrop and a clean, modern login.

lockscreens.name: Swiss
lockscreens.author: ZAAFHachemrachid
lockscreens.summary: One hairline rule and one enormous clock.
lockscreens.description: International-style typography for the lock: a single hairline rule, an oversized clock, a small ticking numeral at the right margin, and a caret that takes your password with no box around it. The margin unit, the rule thickness and the accent all come from theme.conf.

lockscreens.name: Sword
lockscreens.author: Darkkal44
lockscreens.summary: A lone blade planted in a misty grove.
lockscreens.description: A moody, near-monochrome lock: a katana standing point-down among blurred dark trees, with a spare login.

lockscreens.name: Synthwave
lockscreens.author: ZAAFHachemrachid
lockscreens.summary: A neon grid running out to a banded sun.
lockscreens.description: An eighties horizon: a scrolling perspective grid, a banded sun on the skyline, CRT scanlines, and a chromatic-aberrated clock above a hot-neon login. Grid speed, scanline darkness, aberration and the neon hue are all in theme.conf. Ships the Outfit Black display face under the OFL.

lockscreens.name: Terminal
lockscreens.author: ZAAFHachemrachid
lockscreens.summary: A boot log that stops at the login prompt.
lockscreens.description: A single-phosphor console: a typewriter boot log, a blocky seven-segment clock, optional scanlines, and a password prompt that echoes nothing, like sudo. The ink is tinted from your Ryoku palette, or left classic green; echo mode, type speed and scanlines are in theme.conf.

lockscreens.name: Terraria
lockscreens.author: Darkkal44
lockscreens.summary: The Terraria main menu, pixel logo and all.
lockscreens.description: A Terraria title-screen lock with the pixel logo, a tree-lined horizon, and wood-panel buttons.

lockscreens.name: Windows 7
lockscreens.author: Darkkal44
lockscreens.summary: The nostalgic Windows 7 welcome screen.
lockscreens.description: A throwback Windows 7 lock: a round avatar, a glassy credential field, and the familiar blue welcome mood.

lockscreens.description: A moody lo-fi illustration of a walk in the rain, with a calm, understated login.

lockscreens.summary: A lone figure amid drifting ruins under pale light.
lockscreens.description: A Wuthering Waves inspired lock: a desolate greyscale expanse of floating debris cut by a single beam of light, with a modern login.
